name: rentemester-bank-reconciliation-corrections-v33
sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bank_reconciliation_correction_events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  bank_transaction_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_transactions(id),
  supersedes_reconciliation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  superseded_journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  replacement_journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  bank_account_no TEXT NOT NULL,
  bank_amount_dkk REAL NOT NULL,
  replacement_journal_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(plan_hash)=64),
  idempotency_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),
  actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor)) BETWEEN 3 AND 160),
  principal TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(principal)) BETWEEN 3 AND 160),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS bank_reconciliation_correction_events_current_idx ON bank_reconciliation_correction_events(supersedes_reconciliation_id);
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS bank_reconciliation_correction_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON bank_reconciliation_correction_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'bank reconciliation correction events are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS bank_reconciliation_correction_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON bank_reconciliation_correction_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'bank reconciliation correction events are append-only'); END;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS bank_journal_reconciliations;
CREATE VIEW bank_journal_reconciliations AS
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT je.source_bank_transaction_id AS bank_transaction_id, je.id AS journal_entry_id, je.entry_no AS journal_entry_no, 'direct' AS link_kind, 'direct:' || je.id AS reconciliation_id
    FROM journal_entries je WHERE je.source_bank_transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND je.status = 'posted'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT link.bank_transaction_id, je.id, je.entry_no, 'append-only', 'append-only:' || link.id
    FROM bank_journal_reconciliation_links link JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = link.journal_entry_id WHERE je.status = 'posted'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT event.bank_transaction_id, je.id, je.entry_no, 'correction', 'correction:' || event.id
    FROM bank_reconciliation_correction_events event JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = event.replacement_journal_entry_id WHERE je.status = 'posted'
)
SELECT bank_transaction_id, journal_entry_id, journal_entry_no, link_kind, reconciliation_id
  FROM candidates candidate
 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_reconciliation_correction_events event WHERE event.supersedes_reconciliation_id = candidate.reconciliation_id);
